column3: MT 142:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “a maskil” is rendered “A Contemplation.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּהִתְעַטֵּף (“grows faint”) is rendered “was overwhelmed,” and NKJV supplies “Then.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “hand,” and “a place of escape” is rendered “Refuge.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they will surround me” is rendered “The righteous shall surround me,” and the present “you deal bountifully” “You shall deal bountifully.”
